questions.question_text: The diagram shows a cuboid. The volume of this cuboid is 52.5 cm3. Find the value of h.
The diagram shows a pyramid. The area of the base is 500 m2. The height of the pyramid is 27 m. Find the volume of this pyramid.
Find the mean physics mark,
the mean chemistry mark.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x.
Use your regression line to estimate the chemistry mark when the physics mark is 60,
the physics mark is 5.
Which physics mark, 60 or 5, is likely to give the most reliable chemistry mark? Give a reason for your answer.
A student is chosen at random from the 120 students. Calculate the probability that the student chosen is a boy from Class 2,
not from Class 3.
A boy is chosen at random. Calculate the probability that he is from Class 4.
Three students from Class 1 are chosen at random. Calculate the probability 3 girls are chosen.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) where f(x) = 1 / cos(x) for values of x between -270 and 270.
Write down the range of f(x).
On the same diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x) where g(x) = (720 + x) / (2x) for values of x between -270 and 270.
Find the values of the x co-ordinates of the points of intersection of the two graphs.
Find the equation of each asymptote of the graph of y = g(x).
List the elements of set A.
Write all the elements of U in the correct parts of the Venn diagram above.
List the elements of (A union B)'.
Find n((B union C)' intersect A).
Find the co-ordinates of the image of the point (5, 1) under the transformation P.
Find the co-ordinates of the image of the point (x, y) under the transformation P followed by the transformation Q.
Describe fully the single transformation equivalent to P followed by Q.
Describe fully the single transformation equivalent to R followed by S.
Describe fully the single transformation equivalent to the inverse of R.
Sergio invests $2000 at a rate of 3% per year compound interest. Find the value of his investment at the end of 5 years.
After how many complete years is the value of his investment greater than $4000?
Anna invests $2000 at a rate of 0.24% per month compound interest. Find the value of her investment at the end of 5 years.
Calculate the monthly compound interest rate that is equal to a compound interest rate of 3% per year.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x), where f(x) = |x^2 - 4| for values of x between -3 and 3.
Write down the equation of the line of symmetry of the graph.
Write down the zeroes of f(x).
Find the value of k when y = k meets the curve y = |x^2 - 4| three times.
Find the range of values of k when y = k meets the curve y = |x^2 - 4| four times.

Solve the equation 3x + 5 = 7x + 25.
Solve the equation 8x^2 = 11 - 2x.
Solve the inequality 6 - 2x >= 10.
Solve the inequality 1 / (x - 2) > 3.
Solve the simultaneous equations. You must show all your working. 3x + 5y = -3, 5x - 2y = 26
Solve the equation log x + 4 log 2 = log 13.
Write AB as a column vector.
Calculate the length of the line AB.
The point C has co-ordinates (10, k). AB = BC and k >= 0. Show that k = 11.
Find the equation of the line that is perpendicular to AC that passes through the midpoint of AC. Give your answer in the form y = mx + c.
The points A, B, C and D form a rhombus. Find the co-ordinates of D.
Show that FB = 4.781 m, correct to 3 decimal places.
Calculate angle FCB.

Angle ABC = 78°. Find AD.
Find the area of triangle ABD.

Find the value of x when y = 16.
